title: LLM-as-Judge Bias (Mechanistic Interpretability) — Wiki Page (arXiv:2607.11871)
description: New wiki page covering mechanistic interpretability of LLM-as-judge scoring bias. Key finding: bias is a low-dimensional subspace in activation space (not just input-output noise), enabling causal control (steering activations steers scores) and operational prediction (predicts judge failures before scoring). Relevant to dream cycle hypothesis evaluation and H274/H381 bull/bear debate architectures.

source.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
source.authors: Zixiang Xu, Sixian Li, Huaxing Liu, Xiang Wang, Sauai Li, Zirui Song, Xiuying Chen
